name: Microsoft COCO: Common Objects in Context
description: A large-scale dataset for object detection and segmentation in everyday scenes, containing 91 object categories with 2.5 million labeled instances in 328,000 images.
creator: Tsung-Yi Lin, Michael Maire, Serge Belongie, Lubomir Bourdev, Ross Girshick, James Hays, Pietro Perona, Deva Ramanan, C. Lawrence Zitnick, Piotr Dollár (Microsoft Research)
rai:dataCollection: Images were gathered using a novel pipeline that involved extensive crowd worker involvement via Amazon Mechanical Turk, focusing on non-iconic views and contextual relationships.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images were collected from Flickr and other sources, focusing on pairs of object categories and scene/object category pairs.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The annotation process involved multiple stages: category labeling, instance spotting, and instance segmentation, with each image labeled by multiple workers to ensure high quality.
